templates.name: Open equals low
templates.timeframe: Intraday; select a completed candle interval
templates.provenance: Reference adaptation of Streak's documented Open/Low condition; not a downloaded saved scanner
templates.limitations: No entry, stop or exit strategy supplied by this condition

templates.name: Open equals high
templates.timeframe: Intraday; select a completed candle interval
templates.provenance: Reference adaptation of Streak's documented Open/High condition; not a downloaded saved scanner
templates.limitations: No entry, stop or exit strategy supplied by this condition

templates.name: Daily Supertrend with weekly/monthly filters
templates.conditions: Daily close crosses below Supertrend; weekly close > weekly open; monthly RSI > 50
templates.provenance: Published example with a saved Streak scanner link; native page unavailable during review
templates.limitations: Supertrend and RSI periods are not specified in accessible text; requires parameter verification and completed higher-timeframe candles

templates.name: Golden crossover
templates.conditions: DMA 50 > DMA 200 AND DMA 50 previous day < DMA 200 previous day
templates.provenance: Public Search Query retrieved from Screener.in
templates.limitations: DMA is not interchangeable with Trendforge EMA; no execution exits supplied

templates.name: Price volume action
templates.conditions: Volume 1week average > Volume 1year average * 5 AND Return over 1week > 5 AND Market Capitalization > 50
templates.indicators: Weekly/yearly average volume, weekly return, market capitalization
templates.provenance: Public Search Query retrieved from Screener.in
templates.limitations: Needs point-in-time market capitalization in Screener units; no execution exits supplied

templates.name: RSI oversold
templates.provenance: Public Search Query retrieved from Screener.in
templates.limitations: Verify provider RSI convention and point-in-time market capitalization; oversold is not an entry rule
